errors: Syntax error: Bad syntax (expected directive or statement) at Section owl:disjointUnionOf ( :HeaderSection :DetailSection :SummarySection ) .
OOPS Validation Exception: Failed to convert Turtle to RDF/XML at same line.
iterations.fix_plan:
The issue is with the use of owl:disjointUnionOf. In Turtle, owl:disjointUnionOf is used as a property of a class, not as a directive. It must be written as a triple with the class as subject, owl:disjointUnionOf as predicate, and an RDF list as object. Will fix by rewriting these as:
:Section owl:disjointUnionOf ( :HeaderSection :DetailSection :SummarySection ) .
:AgentRole owl:disjointUnionOf ( :BuyerRole :DeliveryPartyRole ) .
But ensure the subject is prefixed with :, not as a directive, and place at the end of class declarations.

errors: Syntax error: Bad syntax (objectList expected) at owl:disjointWith usage inside class block. Turtle does not allow property assertions (owl:disjointWith) inside class declarations using ;. Must be written as separate triples outside the class blocks, e.g. ':Segment owl:disjointWith :Section .'
iterations.fix_plan: Move all owl:disjointWith and owl:disjointUnionOf assertions outside the class blocks. Only use ; for rdfs:label and rdfs:comment inside class declarations. All property assertions must be at the top-level, not inside class definitions.
